question: What does the 1074 that the 2026-10-24 table gives Windscribe under servers count? The vendor's list at https://assets.windscribe.com/serverlist/openvpn/1/1, read on 2026-11-02, holds 361 nodes, each with an ip, an ip2 and an ip3 address (1083 addresses), so 1074 matches a count of addresses, three per node, and not a count of servers.
why: ip-proxy/mullvad-vpn publishes the figure as unverified in extras.asn_comparison.windscribe.servers. The node count belongs in ip-proxy/windscribe-vpn, which already cites the list URL; its extras carry 239 /24s and 58 ASNs on primary addresses and no node count. The notes of ip-proxy/mullvad-vpn give Windscribe's 58 ASNs on 1,074, and the ip-proxy VPN document calls 1,074 IPs.
